human_intent.intent: Website remains a public discovery/SEO façade and routing surface. It must not become a second owner of authentication, pricing, cart/order truth, payments or customer master data.
Customer Cabinet should initially be a CRM user-facing composition capability. Domain data remains owned by IAM, Accounting, Calculator, Operations/Order, Logistics and other canonical owners.

Mobile App is a future potential module. Current priority is responsive/mobile-first Website + Calculator + Customer Portal. Native implementation starts only after evidence of customer scale and native/offline/push value.

SysAdmin becomes an offline-first, recovery-first technical operations layer closely integrated with Operations Assistant. It manages inventories, known-good configurations, technical execution, recovery assets and corporate workstation conformance.
Voice is an input modality, not an authorization mechanism. Speech-to-text must be provider-abstracted and may use a local/offline runtime where practical.

Cloud Backup Manager receives prepared backup artifacts from domain owners, preserves them off-site, verifies integrity/recoverability and supports controlled one-way replication of corporate managed resources.
A temporarily unavailable resource must never be interpreted as deleted or forgotten. Pending operations remain durable with explicit QUEUED/WAITING/RETRY/DEGRADED states, evidence and escalation.

Strategic Control Plane is a long-horizon decision-intelligence layer. It combines internal and external evidence, generates quantified scenarios and recommendations, but never autonomously executes strategic decisions.

Marketing Orchestrator is a brand/content operations module, not merely a post generator. It maintains content freshness/quality, cross-channel campaigns, short video and a controlled brand mascot/character system.

Long-term operator effort should shrink from direct control of all modules to control of a small set of governance/inspection/strategy surfaces. Module autonomy must be evidence-based, bounded, reversible and action-specific.

AI-backed modules require context-budget/episode handoff, durable checkpoints, provider-cost/runway monitoring and early Telegram escalation. Silent degradation from exhausted context or balance is prohibited.

Create a new high-probability Verification Lab module candidate whose job is to systematically generate valid, invalid, edge, adversarial, multilingual, concurrency, resilience and authorization scenarios in a safe test plane.
AI output is never sufficient authorization for a destructive or high-impact action. Structured tool requests pass a deterministic policy/IAM/resource gate before side effects.

Preserve broad engineering freedom in Development Plane while production runtime is non-self-modifying and side-effect bounded. Runtime can propose and evidence improvements; Development implements; Verification tests; Release promotes.

Future modules must follow a canonical maturity sequence from portfolio/ownership definition through development workspace, tests, isolated verification, versioned release, staging/shadow/canary and only then production.
